  - `sorters` (query) — default name — fields: name, description, created, modified — e.g. `name`
- Returns 200: listformdefinitionsbytenantresponse

### POST /form-definitions/v1

`createFormDefinitionV1` — Creates a form definition.



- Scopes: sp:forms:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): createformdefinitionrequest
- Returns 201: formdefinitionresponse

### GET /form-definitions/v1/{formDefinitionID}

`getFormDefinitionByKeyV1` — Return a form definition.

Parameter `{formDefinitionID}` should match a form definition ID.

- Scopes: sp:forms:manage, sp:forms:read
- Parameters:
  - `formDefinitionID` (path, required) — Form definition ID
- Returns 200: formdefinitionresponse

### DELETE /form-definitions/v1/{formDefinitionID}

`deleteFormDefinitionV1` — Deletes a form definition.

Parameter `{formDefinitionID}` should match a form definition ID.

- Scopes: sp:forms:manage
- Parameters:
  - `formDefinitionID` (path, required) — Form definition ID
- Returns 204: nil

### PATCH /form-definitions/v1/{formDefinitionID}

`patchFormDefinitionV1` — Patch a form definition.

Parameter `{formDefinitionID}` should match a form definition ID.

- Scopes: sp:forms:manage
- Parameters:
  - `formDefinitionID` (path, required) — Form definition ID
- Body (application/json): array of operation-2
- Returns 200: formdefinitionresponse

### POST /form-definitions/v1/forms-action-dynamic-schema

`createFormDefinitionDynamicSchemaV1` — Generate json schema dynamically.



- Scopes: sp:forms:manage, sp:forms:read
- Body (application/json): formdefinitiondynamicschemarequest
- Returns 200: formdefinitiondynamicschemaresponse

### POST /form-definitions/v1/import

`importFormDefinitionsV1` — Import form definitions from export.



- Scopes: sp:config:manage, sp:forms:manage
- Body (application/json): array of object
- Returns 202: object

### POST /form-definitions/v1/{formDefinitionID}/upload

`createFormDefinitionFileRequestV1` — Upload new form definition file.

Parameter `{formDefinitionID}` should match a form definition ID.

- Scopes: sp:forms:manage
- Parameters:
  - `formDefinitionID` (path, required) — FormDefinitionID String specifying FormDefinitionID
- Body (multipart/form-data): object
- Returns 201: formdefinitionfileuploadresponse

### GET /form-definitions/v1/{formDefinitionID}/file/{fileID}

`getFileFromS3V1` — Download definition file by fileid.



- Scopes: sp:forms:manage, sp:forms:read
- Parameters:
  - `formDefinitionID` (path, required) — FormDefinitionID Form definition ID
  - `fileID` (path, required) — FileID String specifying the hashed name of the uploaded file we are retrieving.
- Returns 200: string
